source_contains: Neutral T-pose figure and a 4096px color texture; no skeleton, weights or animation
adaptation: Subdivision-smoothed 38,126-triangle mesh, embedded 2K rainbow costume/color bake, 32-bone rig including collarbones, anatomically separated arm/hair weights, eight in-place clips including a hand-held crystal throw. Existing six-joint tail timing and contact landmarks retained; arm contacts exported from the authored poses. Native gaze correction remains bounded at all swimming speeds. Corrected upper-tail and hip-fin region weights so they cannot inherit hair deformation. Refined spine/arm keys, hemisphere-continuous quaternion interpolation, and an exported right-palm grip preserve smooth motion and align the crystal release.
